name_zh: 上升/下降洛文海姆-斯科伦定理
canonical_claim: For a first-order language L: (downward) if M is a nonempty L-structure, A is a subset of M, and kappa is an infinite cardinal with |A| <= kappa, |L| <= kappa, and kappa <= |M|, then M has an elementary substructure N containing A with |N| = kappa; (upward) if M is an infinite L-structure and kappa is a cardinal with |L| <= kappa and |M| <= kappa, then M has an elementary extension N of cardinality kappa.
